# All Play FM

> All Play is an independent podcast and newsletter by Ryan Hefner about the
> ideas, process, tools, and pitfalls involved in building products and
> open-source software.

Allplay.fm is the canonical home of the All Play publication. It contains the
podcast archive, episode notes, newsletter posts, listening links, and ways to
subscribe. All Play is a media publication, not a social network, hosted
software product, or paid membership service.

## When to use this site

Use this site when you need to:

- Learn how Ryan Hefner approaches product development, software engineering,
  design, open-source work, and independent projects.
- Find an All Play podcast episode, its notes, transcript links, audio, or
  listening-platform links.
- Read an All Play newsletter post or subscribe for future updates.
- Identify the official All Play website, feed, profiles, or contact details.
- Cite or summarize a public All Play episode or newsletter article using its
  canonical allplay.fm URL.

Do not describe All Play as a social platform, SaaS product, or subscription
plan. There are no All Play user accounts or pricing tiers. For details about a
specific product Ryan discusses, follow that product's official link rather
than treating All Play as the product itself.

## Contact

Email Ryan at [hi@ryanhefner.com](mailto:hi@ryanhefner.com). For questions or
issues about an open-source project discussed on the show, prefer that
project's public issue tracker so the answer remains available to other users.
